name: Callab AI
long_description:
Callab AI is a human-centered customer engagement platform for enterprise contact centers. It lets teams deploy AI agents that handle inbound and outbound conversations across voice, chat, and messaging, while human agents and supervisors stay in control of every interaction.

The platform has two sides. The AI side lets teams build, deploy, and evaluate voice and text agents using a shared knowledge base, embedded evaluations, post-call analysis, data extraction, batch calling, and call transfer. The human side provides a dialer and a live supervision dashboard, from which a person can watch any AI conversation in real time, step in, and hand it back without the customer repeating a word.

Every agent retains memory across channels, so a customer who called yesterday and writes today is recognized and picked up where they left off. The system learns from each human intervention and improves in the direction the team chooses.

Callab AI runs on its own carrier-grade telephony stack and connects natively to Cisco, Mitel, Avaya, SIP trunks, and on-premises PBX systems. Enterprises can adopt it without migrating to the cloud first. The platform maintains SOC 2 controls and serves customers in financial services, healthcare, hospitality, and retail.

Key features:

- AI voice and text agents: Agents handle inbound and outbound conversations across phone, chat, and messaging from a single configuration.

- Live human supervision: Supervisors watch any AI conversation in real time and take over without the customer repeating a word.

- Persistent memory: Every customer's full context is retained across channels and over time.

- AI builder: Teams design, test, and deploy agents without engineering support.

- Embedded evaluations: Every conversation is scored continuously, so performance is measured rather than assumed.

- Self-improving agents: Agents learn from human interventions and get better with every conversation.

- Post-call analysis and data extraction: Every conversation becomes structured, searchable records.

- Batch calling and call transfer: Outbound campaigns run at scale, and conversations move to a human with full context attached.

- Native telephony integration: The platform connects directly to Cisco, Mitel, Avaya, SIP trunks, and on-premises PBX without cloud migration.

- SOC 2 controls: Security and compliance support deployments in regulated industries.

Callab AI delivers every agent production-ready. Our team studies the customer's workflows, internal processes, and existing systems, then builds, tests, and implements the agent on that foundation, so it performs to the organization's own standard from the first live conversation.

launches.title: Callab AI - AI voice agents for legacy phone systems.
launches.tagline: AI voice agents for enterprise contact centers running on legacy phone infrastructure
launches.body:
Hey YC,

We are Haithem and Chehir - co-founders of  [Callab AI](https://callab.ai/). 

**The problem**

The global call center industry is worth $400B, and about 58% of it still runs on on-prem PBX infrastructure like Cisco UCM, Mitel, and FreeSWITCH. These systems have been in place for 20 years, with millions invested in deploying and maintaining them. They work, and they're not going anywhere.

AI voice agents have been built on top of cloud telephony providers, which means every solution on the market today requires the customer to already be on cloud phone systems. If you're running on-prem, you're locked out. The only option is a full migration to cloud, which typically takes 12 to 18 months, costs a fortune, and frequently fails. Meanwhile, these same companies are dealing with 30 to 40% agent attrition rates, rising labor costs, and customers who won't tolerate hold times. They want automation but they simply can't access it.

That's a massive segment of a $400B market sitting there with no solution available to them.

**What we built**

Callab AI is a cloud-based AI voice platform that connects directly to on-prem PBX systems via SIP trunk integration. The phone system stays exactly where it is, calls get routed to our AI agents, handled, and returned. No rip-and-replace, no migration, and we go live in one week.

We automate up to 70% of inbound call volume across use cases like call routing, appointment scheduling, order status, and customer inquiries. The hard part is the integration layer itself, which requires going deep into legacy telecom infrastructure that most teams don't want to touch. We built it to work with any telephony stack, and that's what makes this possible.

We're YC P25 and currently expanding into the US, focused on hospitality, logistics, retail chains, and property management. Healthcare and financial services are on the roadmap once we complete HIPAA compliance.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101754&key=user_uploads/1938837/5d95733e-2ac9-45b4-8f2b-5ef8a8a3b8ca)

**How we got here**

We didn't set out to become the on-prem PBX company. We started building AI voice agents in the Middle East and Africa, where cloud telephony providers don't operate, SIP trunks are state-regulated, and every contact center runs legacy infrastructure. We had no choice but to build our integration layer to work directly with whatever phone system was already on the ground. After plugging into old telecom stacks, we realized the problem we solved out of necessity in MEA is the exact same problem sitting untouched in the US. The constraint that shaped our product in a harder market turned out to be a global advantage.

**How you can help**

If you know anyone at a company running a legacy phone system or on-prem contact center, we'd love an intro. Hotels, restaurant groups, logistics operators, large retail, or property management are all ideal. Also happy to connect with anyone who's worked with managed service providers, value-added resellers, or sold into enterprise telecom IT. Drop me a note.
